what: Golden scenarios computed by kenyon.model.mushroom_body.MushroomBody (torch float32) on the MaleCNS wiring, for exact-parity tests of the browser engine. Model outputs on the scanned wiring, not measurements from a fly.

conventions.odour: a list of channel indices into circuit.glomeruli (olfactory) or circuit.visual_channels (visual); every projection neuron of each channel is set to 1
conventions.train: applied in order from the untrained circuit (W = 1 on every KC->MBON synapse); odour null = no Kenyon-cell activity
conventions.kc: sorted indices of the Kenyon cells that fire (binary code); must match exactly
conventions.mbon_before / mbon_after: drive onto each of the 97 MBONs (circuit.mbon order); before = W = 1
conventions.drop_X: 1 - sum(after over the MBONs of X) / sum(before over them); null when X has no drive
conventions.choices: P(x over y) = sigmoid(beta * (score x - score y))
conventions.floats: float32 results printed with 9 significant digits; integers where the value is integral

scenarios.title: Eight odours, no training
scenarios.status: wiring (PN->KC synapses) through a hand-set top-5% rule
scenarios.shows: Each odour lights its own sparse set of 188 Kenyon cells; codes overlap little.

model.lr_source: calibrate_lr on odour A, punish compartment, target 0.9

scenarios.title: Odour A paired once with punishment (PPL101)
scenarios.status: paired drop at MBON11: CALIBRATION (lr set so this is 0.90; not a result). Unpaired drops, and where the lost drive lands: wiring
scenarios.shows: The memory stays with odour A and lands on MBON11.

model.lr_source: calibrate_lr on odour A, punish compartment, target 0.9

scenarios.title: Odour A punished 1 to 8 times
scenarios.status: the rule's closed form 1-(1-lr*delta)^p for A (calibration and rule, not wiring); unpaired odours: wiring
scenarios.shows: More pairings, deeper memory; the unpaired odours follow their overlap with A.

model.lr_source: calibrate_lr on odour A, punish compartment, target 0.9

scenarios.title: Odour C paired once with reward (PAM)
scenarios.status: wiring (the PAM compartments; reward is also a depression, Owald et al. 2015)
scenarios.shows: Reward lands in other compartments (MBON03, 05, 06), not on MBON11.

model.lr_source: calibrate_lr on odour C, punish compartment, target 0.9

scenarios.title: A punished, then C rewarded
scenarios.status: wiring (different compartments); choice size from the fitted gain
scenarios.shows: Two memories in different compartments coexist, and the modelled choices order correctly.

scenarios.title: A punished, then B punished (same compartment)
scenarios.status: NEGATIVE, the published rule: the second memory overwrites the first
scenarios.shows: Real flies hold both; this rule keeps only a fraction of A's memory.

scenarios.status: RULE CHANGE (recover_rate 0), not the published rule
